name: mailmask
description: Manage your MailMask email domains, addresses and shared inbox from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: MailMask (mailmask.studio) gives you professional email on your own domain: forwarding addresses, mailboxes, DNS, and a shared team inbox. This app lets you work with your account from ChatGPT: list your domains and check their health, see and create email addresses, review DNS records, browse your shared inbox in an interactive view (unread, urgent and assigned conversations, with the full thread and internal notes) and close, snooze or flag conversations, have ChatGPT draft replies that you approve before they are sent, and look at sending logs. Payments are never made inside ChatGPT: they always open as a link on mailmask.studio. Sign-in uses your MailMask account through OAuth; the app only sees what you can see in MailMask, and you can revoke access at any time.
